title: Wheels
blurb: One spin each, then it is pure luck. Spin them whenever you pass; none of them care how long you wait.

rows.name: Wheel of Excitement
rows.need: Land on the 20,000 NP space.

rows.name: Brightvale
rows.need: Land on the 8-pointed star on the Wheel of Knowledge.

rows.name: Mediocrity
rows.need: Land on the 4,000 NP space. No notification is shown, so check your count after.

rows.name: Wheel of Monotony
rows.need: Land on the "?" space. One spin takes hours to finish.

rows.name: Tick Tock
rows.need: Pay at least 100,000 NP to grease the Wheel of Monotony. Awarded on top of your normal prize.

rows.name: High Roller
rows.need: Land on the blank square on the Wheel of Extravagance. Costs 100,000 NP a spin.

title: Luck dailies
blurb: Random on a daily you are doing anyway. Nothing to buy and nothing to time — just keep turning up.

rows.name: Snowager - Rawr!
rows.need: Get blasted. Any blast counts. The app already reminds you at 6am, 2pm and 10pm.

rows.name: Forgotten Shore
rows.need: Random on the daily prize.

rows.name: Geraptiku - Deserted Tomb
rows.need: Random when you win an item.

rows.name: Sssidney
rows.need: Win any prize on a Deserted Fairground scratchcard.

rows.name: Aisha Scalawag
rows.need: Random when you win anything at Buried Treasure, booby prize included.

rows.name: Tombola
rows.need: Keep pulling tickets; several avatars sit behind daily luck like this.

rows.name: Grundo - Discarded Plushie
rows.need: Random on the daily prize. Odds go up during the Winter Starlight Celebration.

rows.name: Edna - Cackle!
rows.need: Random when you finish an Edna quest that asked for three items.

rows.name: Lever of Doom
rows.need: Random when the lever steals 100 NP off you.

rows.name: Dark Lurker
rows.need: Random when you buy from any Haunted Woods, Deserted Fairground or Neovian shop.

title: Luck-based games
blurb: Chance-based games, with some choices along the way. Check off each avatar when awarded; some games cost NP per attempt.

rows.name: Double or Nothing
rows.need: Skeith - Snargan: collect your winnings at 320 NP.

rows.name: Dice-A-Roo
rows.need: Win the jackpot to receive the avatar.

rows.name: Kiss the Mortog
rows.need: Mortog Smooch: choose four correctly in a row, then collect 5,900 NP.

rows.name: Cheeseroller
rows.need: Techo - Cheesy: a random award after finishing in 60 seconds or less.

rows.name: Grarrl Keno
rows.need: Randomly awarded while playing; four matches are not a guarantee.

rows.name: Tyranu Evavu
rows.need: Get at least 15 correct guesses in a row.

rows.name: Gormball
rows.need: Gormball - Gargarox: win a game.

rows.name: Kacheek Seek
rows.need: Must... Keep... Smiling...: randomly awarded after a win.

rows.name: Poogle Racing
rows.need: Poogle Racing Winner: win a Poogle Race.

title: Pets you would need
blurb: Each of these needs a particular species. Making a basic pet is free, so the top group costs nothing but a pet slot. The painted ones need a paint brush or a morphing potion.

rows.name: Feed Me
rows.need: Make a Skeith, feed it any item with "skeith" in the name. Skeith Juice Cocktail is 100 NP.

rows.name: Bless you, Shoyru
rows.need: Make a Shoyru, bless it with a Weak Bottled Faerie. About 90 NP.

rows.name: Lenny - Wicked
rows.need: Make a Lenny, feed it any Spooky Food.

rows.name: Tuskaninny - Spotted
rows.need: Make a Tuskaninny, hold any item with "spotted" in the name, visit its lookup.

rows.name: Elephante Surprise
rows.need: Make an Elephante, feed it a Bag of Peanuts. About 28,000 NP.

rows.name: Clever Thief
rows.need: Make a Gelert, equip a Thief Dagger, then battle once.

rows.name: Jetsam - Wanna Fight?
rows.need: Make a Jetsam, win one 1-player Battledome fight. No notification is shown.

rows.name: Shoyru - Tough!
rows.need: Same Shoyru as above. Win a 1-player fight. Two-player does not count.

rows.name: Hello, little Lupe... BOOOM!
rows.need: Make a Lupe, win a fight, the Chia Clown is the usual target.

rows.name: Werelupe
rows.need: Own a Halloween Lupe and open its lookup.

rows.name: Island Quiggle
rows.need: Own an Island Quiggle that is 30+ days old.

rows.name: Grundo - Forever Orange
rows.need: Own an Orange Grundo and open its lookup.

rows.name: Wocky - Snow Day
rows.need: Own any Snow pet that is 100+ days old.

rows.name: Blumaroo - Fire!
rows.need: A Fire Blumaroo with a petpet 30+ days old whose name contains "fire".

rows.name: Ruki - Mummified
rows.need: A Halloween Ruki with a 30+ day old Mummy Baby attached. The Mummy Baby is only 3,950 NP.

rows.name: Robot Vandagyre
rows.need: A Robot Vandagyre with a Robot-painted petpet, viewed as your active pet.
